newsitem.title: USA: Standard Financial buyback plan expires.
newsitem.headline: Standard Financial buyback plan expires.

text.p: Standard Financial Inc said Monday its share repurchase authorization expired January 24.

The company said it bought back 235,000 common shares since the stock repurchase plan was approved by its board of directors last July 24. The stock will be used to fulfill the company's benefit plan obligations, Standard Financial said.
The bank holding company said it currently has about 16.2 million outstanding common shares.
Standard Financial operates 14 fulll-service banking offices.
Its shares were trading up 3/4 Monday at 20-7/8.
